title: The page writer's wake lists every owner ask with no reply, so a routed ask is also closed on the page
why: Triage 12:36 CST Nov 8, its own mistake: ask ask-mw8321blnx (11:05 CST) was routed to step stray-push-ask-source but never closed on the page, so the owner saw no answer for 90 minutes. The feedback-inbox Stop hook surfaced it. Fix: the waiting-page skill's wake query lists asks with no status or reply, and the Stop check refuses while one is older than the last wake.
note: Coordinator 12:37 CST Nov 8: a lane starts now. Coordinator 14:42 CST Nov 8: #2268 with runner 8; #2246 closed as superseded.
